name: Living Bark
summary: Armor that regrows on its own: whoever wears it learns not to die.

face.name: Living Bark

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: Assign Living Bark to an Auros Entity: that Entity gets +1 Power and gains Stasis (if it would die blocking, it stays permanently tapped).

face.flavor: Cut it if you like. Tomorrow it will be thicker than yesterday.
